reasoning_trace.value: The paper presents the Human-Enhanced Robot Orchestration (HERO) framework, which enables context-aware, real-time robot process orchestration across cloud-edge nodes. The framework supports adaptive and dynamic offloading, container-based process orchestration, and context-aware workload placement for robotic applications. The system mechanism involves monitoring compute status, network bandwidth, and battery levels to make real-time decisions for offloading processes to idle robots, edge servers, or the cloud.
